status_text: The ok / nok status of this part is recorded in the internal licence register, not in this file.
scope_notes: This part covers the `contracts/` folder: the Solidity contracts deployed on Celo mainnet (chain 42220) and the npm package `@selfxyz/contracts`. The package version on npm is 1.2.5. `contracts/package.json` on `origin/dev` says 1.2.5, and the Solidity sources and package.json on `origin/dev` are identical to commit `a31032a07`, where 1.2.5 was set. That the npm tarball was published from that commit is an inference; the registry was not queried.

Tier decision, recorded 2026-11-25 by the audit owner: contracts deployed on-chain are treated like a backend for the licence policy, because they are deployed and not shipped in an app or SDK. Under that tier GPL-3.0 code is allowed, so the 87 GPL-3.0 verifier contracts are listed as a flag. The npm package `@selfxyz/contracts` stays in the distributed tier; its 12 shipped Solidity files are all MIT.

Deployed on Celo mainnet, per the repo: `contracts/ignition/deployments/chain-42220/deployed_addresses.json` has 110 entries (87 verifiers, hub proxy and implementations, registry proxies and implementations, PoseidonT3, CustomVerifier). `contracts/deployments/registry.json` (`lastUpdated` 2026-03-02) lists the proxies under `networks.celo`: IdentityVerificationHub (version 2.13.0), IdentityRegistry for passport, ID card, Aadhaar (each 1.2.0) and KYC (1.0.0), and PCR0Manager (1.2.0). `VerifyAll` has an empty address in `registry.json`. The `README.md` address table is stale.

The repo records no single deployment commit. A full commit SHA is recorded for two items only: PCR0Manager (`5787cff3`) and the KYC registry implementation (`03876a86`); both exist in the repo. The hub 2.13.0 entry has the short SHA `88ae00b1`, which is not in the repo object store, and no git tag exists for it. The `gitCommit` field is empty for the passport, ID card and Aadhaar registries (1.2.0). Verifiers and libraries have no commit record. `origin/dev` is the best available source tree; it is not proven to equal the deployed source.

Inconsistencies inside the repo: `registry.json` gives the current hub implementation as `0x0D91...20B5`, while the Ignition state `DeployNewHubAndUpgradee#IdentityVerificationHubImplV2` is `0xa267...82B3`. `registry.json` gives PCR0Manager `0x9743...4717`; `ignition/deployments/prod` lists `0xE36d...C8B8`. `UPGRADE_GUIDE.md` mentions hub v2.14 and v2.15 while `registry.json` records 2.13.0, so the sources on `origin/dev` may be ahead of what is deployed. Which implementation is live was not checked on chain.

SPDX identifiers in the 159 .sol files under `contracts/contracts`: GPL-3.0 in 87 files (all under `verifiers/`), MIT in 72 files, none with another or missing identifier. No copyright holder other than 0KIMS (verifiers) was found outside `verifiers/`; `@author` appears only as "Self Team" in two files.

The 87 verifier files are `verifiers/{disclose 4, dsc 23, gcp 1, register 30, register_aadhaar 1, register_id 27, register_kyc 1}`. In all 87: the first line is `// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0`, the header reads "Copyright 2021 0KIMS association" and "This file is generated with snarkJS", and the GPL text says "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version". They match the 87 verifier entries in the chain-42220 deployment file one to one (86 `DeployAllVerifiers#Verifier_*` plus `DeployKycRegistryModule#Verifier_gcp_jwt`). They are not in the npm package: the `files` list contains no verifier. No Solidity file outside `verifiers/` imports a verifier file.

Found by hand, not in the SBOM: Solidity compiled into the deployed contracts, from the import closure of the deployed roots. Project files: 87 GPL-3.0 verifiers plus 36 MIT files. External: `@openzeppelin/contracts` and `@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable` 5.4.0 (MIT); `@zk-kit/imt.sol` 2.0.0-beta.12 `InternalLeanIMT.sol` (MIT, package LICENSE MIT, Ethereum Foundation 2024) with its `Constants.sol`, whose header reads `SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED` (it only defines `SNARK_SCALAR_FIELD`); `poseidon-solidity` 0.0.5 `PoseidonT3.sol` (MIT per package.json and SPDX; the tarball has no LICENSE file). Versions are the ones in the `origin/dev` lockfile, not proven to match deployment. Compiler: solc 0.8.28, optimizer 200 runs, evm cancun.

Found by hand, not in the SBOM: `hardhat/console.sol` is imported by `IdentityVerificationHubImplV2.sol`, `Formatter.sol` and `RegisterProofVerifierLib.sol`. No `console.*` call exists in any .sol file, so nothing from it should be in bytecode (source-level reading; nothing was compiled).
Found by hand, not in the SBOM: the two forge libs under `contracts/lib` are git submodules and are used only by tests and scripts, not by deployed bytecode (see the checklist answers).

npm package `@selfxyz/contracts` 1.2.5. The `files` list has 12 Solidity files under `contracts/` (ISelfVerificationRoot, Formatter, SelfVerificationRoot, SelfStructs, IIdentityVerificationHubV2, AttestationId, CircuitConstantsV2, IRegisterCircuitVerifier, IDscCircuitVerifier, SelfUtils, CountryCode, IPoseidonT3); all 12 are SPDX MIT. The only non-relative import in them is `hardhat/console.sol` in `Formatter.sol` line 4; `hardhat` is a devDependency only. The `license` field is `MIT`.

`contracts/LICENSE` (MIT, Copyright 2025 Social Connect Labs, Inc.) was added in commit `4ecfd3406` on 2026-11-24, after 1.2.5. No earlier LICENSE file existed in `contracts/` and there is no `.npmignore`, so the 1.2.5 tarball very likely has no LICENSE file. The registry tarball was not inspected.

`hardhat-contract-sizer` is in the runtime `dependencies` of `contracts/package.json`; only `contracts/hardhat.config.ts` imports it and none of the 12 shipped files does. Its peer dependency is `hardhat ^2.0.0`. The scanner does not follow peer dependencies, so the MPL-2.0 `@ethereumjs/util` 9.1.0 and `@ethereumjs/rlp` 5.0.2 reached through that peer are counted as prod by the scan only because the lockfile records the edge; npm 7 or later would install them as part of hardhat's tree.
`@safe-global/*`, `axios`, `dotenv`, `node-forge` and `@ashpect/smt` are runtime dependencies of the package although the shipped files are Solidity only.
The list comes from `pnpm-lock.yaml` at `origin/dev`, importer `contracts`, not the lockfile at deployment or publish time. A consumer's install resolves the declared ranges again.
not_verified: The commit or release behind each mainnet deployment (see the scope notes).
On-chain state: no RPC calls were made, so which hub implementation is live, and whether on-chain bytecode matches any source here, are not verified.
Which solc, OpenZeppelin and zk-kit versions were used at deployment. The `origin/dev` lockfile versions were used; the prod Ignition artifacts carry no build-info.
That the npm tarball 1.2.5 was published from `a31032a07` and has no LICENSE file: the registry was not queried (first-party name).
Whether the standalone `PoseidonT3` library at `0xF134...1581` compiles from the sources on `origin/dev`; its provenance is inferred from `foundry.toml` and the prod artifact `sourceName`.
Licences of the lockfile packages come from registry metadata or the lookup cache; per-package LICENSE files were read only for the Solidity packages named above.
Static analysis only: nothing was compiled, so "console.sol not in bytecode" and the inlining of `Constants.sol` are source-level readings.
The two submodules were not cloned; their licences were read from the GitHub contents API at the pinned SHAs.

CocoaPods and Gradle native dependencies.result: Not applicable. The contracts part has no native dependencies.

Circom includes.result: Not applicable to the contracts part.

Forge libs.result: Two, both git submodules, used by tests and scripts only and not in deployed bytecode. `contracts/lib/forge-std` at `8e40513d`: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE exist at that commit); imported only by `contracts/script/MigratePCR0Manager.s.sol` and `contracts/test/foundry/*.t.sol`. `contracts/lib/openzeppelin-foundry-upgrades` at `cbce1e00`: MIT (Copyright 2023-2025 Zeppelin Group Ltd); imported only by `test/foundry/UpgradeToAccessControl.t.sol`. `remappings.txt` maps OpenZeppelin to `node_modules`, not to `lib/`.

Own licence.result: `contracts/LICENSE` is MIT, added after 1.2.5. `contracts/package.json` has `"license": "MIT"` (since 2024-10-17). 72 .sol files carry SPDX MIT. The 87 verifier files carry SPDX GPL-3.0 and the 0KIMS snarkJS header. The root `LICENSE` is a pointer text.

Each flagged prod dependency.result: Traced for each row. The 87 verifiers ship as deployed contracts and are not in the npm package. `@ashpect/smt` and `node-forge` are installed by the consumer and are not Solidity. The two MPL-2.0 rows are reached only through the hardhat peer of `hardhat-contract-sizer`. The GPL and LGPL packages are devDependencies and are not in the package files list or in bytecode.

Git submodules.result: The two `contracts/lib` submodules (forge-std, openzeppelin-foundry-upgrades) belong to this part; see the Forge libs answer. `packages/mobile-sdk-alpha/mobile-sdk-native` does not.

Vendored binaries.result: None found in `contracts/` by the scanner's file listing. The Ignition folders hold JSON artifacts and addresses.

Fonts.result: Not applicable. There are no fonts in `contracts/`.

Git or URL dependencies.result: `@ashpect/smt` (runtime dependency, `https://github.com/ashpect/smt#main`, locked at commit `4f73fd24`): MIT, read from package.json and LICENSE in the tarball at that commit. `snarkjs` 0.5.0 fork `sampritipanda/snarkjs` at `fef81fc5` (dev closure via `@anon-aadhaar/core`): GPL-3.0. `valid-url` 1.0.9 has no licence field in the registry; its published package carries an MIT LICENSE file.

Pods and local Gradle modules.result: Not applicable. There are no pods or Gradle modules in this part.

Code cloned or downloaded at build time.result: None found. `@ashpect/smt` is fetched from GitHub when the package is installed.

Source files copied from other projects.result: Only the 87 snarkJS-generated verifier files (0KIMS association header, GPL-3.0). No "adapted from", "copied from" or "forked" comments and no other copyright holder were found in the Solidity sources outside `verifiers/`.

Android: is the Gradle list.result: Not applicable. There is no Gradle build in this part.

LGPL: how is it linked.result: One LGPL-3.0 package, `web3-utils` 1.10.4, in the devDependency closure. It is not in the package files list, not imported by shipped Solidity and not in bytecode.

Attribution.result: The 1.2.5 tarball very likely has no LICENSE file (added afterwards; registry not checked). The 87 verifier sources carry their GPL-3.0 and 0KIMS header in the file. Not otherwise checked.
